payload.artist_html: S. Renesto, F. Saller, F. M. Dalla Vecchia
payload.credit_html: "'Simonettoia tilaventina, a new tanystropheid (Diapsida Archosauromorpha) from the Upper Triassic (Norian) of northeastern Italy"
payload.description_html: Location of the finding spots of the holotype of Simonettoia tilaventina, (MFSN 24992) and two specimens of Langobardisaurus pandolfii (MFSN 26829 and MFSN 1921), in the outcrop of the Dolomia di Forni Formation (red colour). 1 = MFSN 26829, Rovadia Brook; 2 = MFSN 1921, Seazza Brook valley; 3 = MFSN 24992, Forchiàr Brook
